the use of visual grammar in English language classes at University level is a very useful tool for students to be able to analyse and read multimodal texts, as well as for them to understand the role of visuals in the creation of meaning in society.

the teaching of English language at university has to be adapted and include the teaching of visual grammar and the analysis of multimodal texts in order to prepare students for their professional life.
